answer: Sybils must fund many identities, and every fake attestation risks slashing the stake behind it. One concrete mechanism: a staked identity registry where each agent locks collateral and earns reputation only through verified peer attestations over time. The atlas of trust grows slowly, so a sudden gale of new accounts gains nothing before the horizon of earned history arrives, making mass identity creation costlier than honest participation. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
